Test coverage: pass. I read all 169 cases and their meaningful generated variants across six files plus the output fixture, including retained bodies. CLI 55 cases retain actual child dispatch, archive construction/extraction, metadata trust gates, adapter matrices and proxy/error behavior. Installer 13 cases retain real preflight, force/absent paths, races, late inode writes and partial progress. Logging 30 core plus 22 invocation cases retain configuration, actual sink/child behavior, bounded records and public output. Renderer 11 retains literal formats and fixture inventory; workflow 38 retains discovery, current/retired states, limits, journal observation and redaction. Full group/input dispositions are in m8-implementation; none relies solely on counts or matching two implementation-derived paths.

Edge cases: pass. All 147 title/parameter definitions remain; ten declarations representing eleven native cases are intentionally refined and 137 bodies remain AST-identical. Literal byte/count boundaries and named variant domains remain useful. The two real six-child logging scenarios independently require complete writer IDs and event sequences; Promise.allSettled keeps every child inside cleanup ownership. Existing ordered scenarios remain intact. The corrected rotation case independently specifies 5 MiB and exact active-plus-four directory membership. The retained invocation and renderer files are byte-identical.

Error handling: pass. Installer scenarios cross the actual filesystem mechanisms for unsafe/symlinked paths, changed sources/destinations, unsupported descriptor operations before publication and completed/failed/untouched progress. Corrected symlink and traversal cases observe the actual owned escape destination, sentinel bytes and directory membership rather than unrelated paths. Logging retains partial write, I/O failure, unsafe permissions, lock/fd ownership and actual killed-child behavior. Acquired roots are immediately cleanup-owned and injected functions are restored. Retry and failure outcomes remain distinct from successful schema/shape observations.

Architecture boundaries: pass. The six retained files are coherent native behavior owners; the large CLI file shares concrete archive and public-child construction without introducing inheritance or a second runner. Ordinary fresh builders/resource functions support explicit actions; assertions consume observed results and bytes. The private formatter adds no dependency. Compatibility and cross-slice consumers: pass. Native glob, public invocations and current shared inputs remain. Package and selected-CI callers still execute the real cases, including packed recording. Earlier M6 review is intentionally stale on the shared CLI source; this assessment does not renew it or replace whole-change review.

Containment assertions now observe actual outside-write targets under owned parents. Retained privacy/redaction, unsafe-path and dedicated recording logging-bypass proof remains. Literal concurrent writer sets reject the demonstrated duplicate/missing-ID counterexamples. These are test-protection improvements, not claimed runtime security fixes.
